description: This Java source file defines the class 'SourceMySqldiffFile', which implements a custom Liquibase task to execute SQL scripts on a MySQL database. It reads a SQL file from the classpath, copies it to a temporary file, constructs a command line to invoke the MySQL client, and executes the script on the database, logging the process and handling errors.
